landing.freeCreditsNote: New accounts start with free credits.
landing.mockPrompt: A website for my coffee shop. Warm, simple, with a menu and opening hours.
landing.stepsTitle: From idea to live site in minutes

describe.title: Describe it
describe.text: Write what you need in plain words: a portfolio, a cafe site, a landing page — or paste a reference URL.

build.title: Watch it get built
build.text: The AI plans the files and writes them one by one. You see the preview as it comes together.

change.title: Change it by chat
change.text: Ask for edits like “make the hero darker”, or open the code and edit it yourself.

ship.title: Publish or export
ship.text: Share a public link, or download the whole React project as a ZIP.

landing.referenceSub: Give Renscraft any public URL — a portfolio, a WordPress blog, a Google Site, a Canva page. It reads the content, mirrors the images into your own storage, and studies the design. You get a site that's inspired by it, not a clone of it.
landing.referenceReading: Reading the page, extracting design tokens…

content.title: Content & copy
content.desc: Headings, paragraphs, structure — the actual text and hierarchy.

images.title: Images & assets
images.desc: Mirrored to our storage, so they never break when the source changes.

colors.title: Colors & shadows
colors.desc: Palette, borders, shadows — the full visual language of the site.

fonts.title: Fonts & typography
fonts.desc: Font families, sizes, weights — everything that sets the tone.

landing.referenceFootnote: Works with React, Next.js, WordPress, Google Sites, Canva, Framer — anything with a public URL.
landing.ctaDiyText: Describe what you need, watch it get built, edit it by chat. Pay per build in rupiah — credits never expire, failed builds are refunded.
landing.ctaCustomText: E-commerce, dashboards, mobile apps, API integrations — hand-built by Rensdev. Fixed scope, fixed price, direct to the developer.
landing.footerTagline: Crafting your web with RensCraft — describe what you need, preview instantly, and ship production-ready React.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Talk to the human who builds this.
contact.subtitle: Renscraft is built and run by one person. Whether it's a bug, a feature idea, a refund, or just a hello — pick whichever channel you prefer. We usually reply within 1 business day.

channels.emailDesc: Best for refund requests, account issues, and anything that needs an order ID.
channels.instagramDesc: Behind-the-scenes of Renscraft, quick questions, and design updates.
channels.githubDesc: Source code, issue tracker, and open-source bits of the Renscraft stack.
channels.tiktokDesc: Short demos, tips, and the occasional build-in-public clip.

contact.refundText: Include the order ID from the Top-up modal (Recent orders).
contact.bugText: Describe what you did, what you expected, and what happened. Screenshots help a lot.
contact.featureText: Just describe it in one paragraph. No formal template needed.
contact.accountText: Send from the email you signed up with, so we can find you faster.
